messages.speaker: them
messages.text: PTA se official call hai. Aap ke CNIC par registered 6 SIMs hain jin ka misuse ho raha hai.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Sirf 2 SIM meri hain to baaki kiski?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Wahi to problem hai. Block karwane ke liye hum ne aap ko verification code bheja hai.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Code yahan type kar dein ya bata dein, main note kar leta hoon.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Perfect. Ab biometric verify karne ke liye 999 rupay charge bhejein Easypaisa se, process turant start hoga.
